item.title: Several homes ablaze as firefighters try to contain West Midlands grassfire
item.summary: About 60 crew responding to blaze covering about 16 hectares near Stourbridge golf course Several homes were ablaze and two people were receiving treatment as firefighters attempted to contain a grassfire in the West Midlands on Thursday. The region’s fire service was alerted to an extensive grassfire near Stourbridge golf course just before 1.30pm on Thursday. Continue reading...
